Equal angles of elevation mean equal horizontal distances, so the two positions are mirror images in the line joining the centre of the circle to the point — which places the plane \(210^\circ\) short of that point at time \(t\). Covering \(210^\circ\) takes \(\dfrac{210}{2} = 105\) seconds, so \(x = 105\).

solution: In an isosceles trapezium the angles at each parallel side are equal, which makes every pair of opposite angles add to \(180^\circ\), and that is exactly the condition for a quadrilateral to be cyclic. In a cyclic parallelogram the opposite angles are equal because it is a parallelogram and supplementary because it is cyclic, so each must be \(90^\circ\) and the figure is a rectangle. solution: Let the ladder reach a height \(h\) on the wall, so that \(h^2 + 2.5^2\) is its squared length. Setting \(r\sqrt{3} = 10\sqrt{3}\) gives \(r = 10\) cm and a diameter of \(20\) cm.
